label: early original-phase input of b/k/j/h/v/i
explanation: Fires almost only during the original (input) phase at the first four positions (t<=3 holds ~97% of activation mass; essentially silent at the delimiter and in the copy phase, and rare after t=4). Within that window it is token-selective: b is strongest (rate 27%, 31% of mass), then k, j, h, v, i; other tokens fire weakly. Magnitude is largest for b, especially repeated b or b after an earlier b (top examples: b b b, z b b). It is also history-dependent: the same token in the same position is often inactive, and some activations fall on other tokens after an earlier b. First occurrences of a token make up 93% of the mass. Shorter sequences fire at higher rates. Predicate captures ~82% of mass at precision ~0.58.
